title: The movie theater fire
content: I had another dream involving fire and time manipulation by the mall world. (I must have deleted my earlier post about a mall world fire when I went on a post clearing frenzy a while back, oops. I guess I could post it again but it was long. Summary: 110 story building featuring elevator of doom and several stores/offices with various themes, it was owned by an evil bank, I set it on fire, the building began time traveling and I just kept setting it on fire until it was entirely destroyed.) This time I was watching a movie at the movie theater. This theater was built in a giant theme park, which was themed around the Great Plains and wagon trails and whatnot. The movie theater was called "Oklahoma". Aside from being in a theme park, and having people inside dressed like that time and place, the theater itself looked fairly ordinary. They sold concessions like "Tornado Slushies" and "Prairie Poppers". The movie was about time travelers from the 19th century meeting modern day office workers or something, IDK it wasn't all that great, the acting wasn't good and the quality of the movie looked like it was made on a budget of two dollars and a Domino's pizza. Anyway, the scene suddenly jumped to us all standing outside the theater as it was burning, thick smoke pouring out of every way out. We were asking around trying to figure out if everyone got out, and soon realized none of us remembered what happened or even who we were. Obviously we had been in a fire, and we were watching a movie. So I could remember the basics of the movie, and told everyone what it was about. They all agreed that sounded right but they couldn't remember anything else, either. Once the fire had been stopped, we began touring through the ruins to try and find clues. A firefighter was holding what little remained of a dead body, someone who had been seated on one of the outer seats. One of the group froze in her tracks, recognizing the firefighter as her husband, and yelled "THAT'S ME---!!!" and both her, and her remains, faded away into a light. After this, a voice from apparently the Beyond began calling out, "four." Four. Four. Four. We followed it and it kept getting closer, Four. Four. Four. One of us had a realization, and said "I was in seat four!" The world stopped moving, and the voice now asked, "Which row." The person who had been in "seat four" stopped too, and just went "What...?" "WHICH ROW." We all then watched this person's memory, as she walked through the theater, saying "alright, seat 4, row 28..." And she said "uh, row 28?" The world turned black and white and everything became distorted, faces began melting, and we were all sucked into a whirlpool. Then we were back where we started standing outside the theater, but minus the one from before who recognized her own corpse. We took from this that we can have false memories, memories that probably belong to someone else in the group. So we knew one of us had to be in seat 4, row 28. Heading over there, we found the chair was not harmed by the fire. I sat in it, and was immediately transported back to watching the movie, before the fire happened. I was thinking how much the movie sucked and eating trail mix. I decided to just get up and do something- I couldn't even tell what I was going to do, as I was preparing to do it- and got out of my chair. I walked towards the back of the theater and exited the door...and snapped back to being in the burned out room. I told them what I saw, and one of them goes "Wait...I think you might have started the fire." I asked him why he thought that. He said he saw someone walking out from that direction just seconds before the fire started, and that the fire had started from the door area. I told him this was ridiculous as we weren't the only ones in the theater, that I probably just got up to use the bathroom, and how did he even know either of our memories weren't false? He said "let's test it then! You started the fire!" The voice from Beyond echoed him. The crowd was now surrounding me and chanting "You started the fire! You started the fire!" and I screamed over all of them, "NO! I DID NOT START THE FIRE!" The world began to distort as it had before, faces melting, grainy black and white, whirlpool. As we started to get pulled in by our feet to the center, one of them melted down to a skeleton grabbed my shoulders and looked me in the eye-holes and said "You know what you did." Now we were back where we started, and everyone was staring at me intently. "You said you did not start the fire, and we reset. The room knows. You told it a lie." They all got closer, surrounding me. At this point I just wanted to get out of there, and I said "Fine! I started the fucking fire!" I began to glow with the same blue light as the corpse woman from before and just said, "oh, come on, no..." The crowd was positively furious at this point, but before they could do anything, I faded out of the entire dream and woke up.
